semantic.justification: Task168 implements the actual IndexedStyleSheets dependency created eagerly by SfxStyleSheetBasePool_Impl. Preserve vector identity/position order, name multimap indices, six family vectors, duplicate pointer guard, rebuild/name-change, predicates/count/nth search, callbacks and Clear ordering. Native OUString name equality binds to native JS logical UTF16 Map multivalue keys; no normalization or custom hash buckets. Duplicate-name range order is unspecified by the native unordered_multimap contract; ReturnFirst preserves cardinality and predicate selection without claiming a cross-stdlib particular duplicate. Native rtl::Reference/virtual callback boundaries use JS object references and erased borrowed name/family/callback contracts; no fake SfxStyleSheetBase/Pool or memory/refcount/weak/allocator engine is introduced. Native std::out_of_range and failed family assertions bind to host errors for these defined failure/precondition boundaries; invalid start iterators and dangling native pointers are not assigned invented results. Preserve source Clear omission of family-vector clearing (CALC146); explicit Reindex repairs indices only because upstream does so. Full styles/pool/document/connected UI/ODS remain pending. Task174 independent core-first initialization exposed an eager public-facade cycle after adding derived classes. Original style.hxx enum/borrowed declarations move unchanged into style-values.ts; style.ts reexports the same public values/types/classes. Core,index,iterator and derived implementations import their declaration owner rather than a class facade. This preserves all enum values and method bodies without lazy imports,globals,initialization registries or caller ordering requirements.
